newsitem.title: USA: Pet python wreaks havoc in South Dakota home.
newsitem.headline: Pet python wreaks havoc in South Dakota home.

text.p: A 10-foot (3-metre) python named "Squeezer" escaped from an aquarium and went on a rampage in his owner's home before three people wrestled him into a sack, officials said on Thursday.

The snake's 18-year-old owner, whose name was not released, became concerned when the 2-year-old python broke the glass of his aquarium and pushed aside 60 pounds (27 kgs) of weights that were holding down the top.
"It's not abnormal for a python to become agressive when it gets that age," Don Riech, director of Sioux Falls Animal Control said.
An expert from Riech's office tried to snare Squeezer, but the snake wrapped himself around his owner and sprayed urine all over the apartment.
Three people finally wrestled Squeezer into a sack, and Riech said it took four or five shots from a .22-calibre rifle to kill the snake.
